anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard, which is a technical specification used to organize and share EEG data like the one in this dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz. The experimental paradigm employed a 9x8 checkerboard visual stimulus presentation with target and non-target event classifications. Data were collected in a laboratory environment with online feedback provided to participants. The trial interval was 0-1.0 seconds, and a 60 Hz line frequency filter was applied.
